title: Meta-Priority Engine and Request Funnel for Hosted Chat + Streaming + Tool Calls
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design and implement a meta-priority engine and request funnel for Hosted API feature requests coming from enterprise customers. Scope covers chat, streaming, and tool/function calling flows and structured-output feature asks. Objective: provide a deterministic, SLA-aware scoring pipeline that ranks incoming requests for triage and routing to PM/Eng/Design lanes, surface automated risk signals, and produce dispatch recommendations (e.g., fast-track, research spike, backlog, enterprise escalation). Deliver a lightweight orchestration layer and eval hooks that can be consumed by Console intake UI and by the internal intake API.
acceptance_criteria: 1) A scoring rubric implementation that produces repeatable priority scores and exposes signal weights (SLA, revenue, security, complexity, reuse). 2) Integration prototype with intake form (Console) and an endpoint that returns routing recommendation. 3) Documentation of signals and thresholds + a dashboard showing distribution and historical changes. 4) Playbook for SLA-driven fast-track and a canary plan for rollout to enterprise customers.
